item.title: The Lost City of Choris Fos (Seeking Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout: SCP Mission Logs & Field Tests

Elevator Pitch: A city that was discovered 12 miles out of Athens Greece that can only be seen and visited after sunset every other Sunday.

Central Narrative: The city was large part of Greek trade and power until the "Gods" judged the city leaving it cursed. Those in the city are cursed with immortality as well as being unable to leave the city. those outside have forgotten the city and it appears nowhere in any Greek history. Those in the city also seem to rely on an unlimited source of food and water and seem to receive items on a weekly schedule from what would be seen in ancient Greece.

Hook/Attention Grabber: Those who enter the city may interact and leave anytime before sunrise. Those who don't leave in time will be subjected to the same curse and will be unable to leave.

Additional Notes: The people of the city physically cannot die but can feel all the pain that would come there way via starvation, thirst, or suffering a wound.
